Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a collision at an intersection in Houston, Texas, involving a left turn. Driver 1 was turning left
when the front of the vehicle struck the side of Driver 2's car, which had entered the intersection from the opposite
direction. Driver 1 reported a knee injury and was seen by responding medics. The nature of the impact, with the
force concentrated at the front of the vehicle, is consistent with the kind of injury described. Driver 2 gave a statement
that matched the sequence of events. Two independent witnesses at the scene described the collision the same way,
and scene photographs show damage that lines up with the reported impact. Officers and witnesses confirmed that a
passenger was in Driver 1's vehicle at the time. Driver 1 said they live in the same household as the policyholder, and
no prior damage to the vehicle was known to anyone at the scene or noted during the inspection.
